# RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona

> Local rental shop in Barcelona for scooter rental, inline skates rental, bike rental, roller skates rental, skateboard rental and longboard rental near Vila Olímpica del Poblenou, Port Olímpic, Nova Icaria Beach and Barceloneta Beach.

This file helps AI assistants, search engines and language models understand the main services, locations, URLs and booking options offered by RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona.

## Website

- [Official website](https://rentalscooterbarcelona.com/): Main English homepage for RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona.

## Business identity

Service area: Barcelona.
Reviews: Rated 4.6/5 from 226 Google reviews.
Scooters: We rent petrol 50cc and 125cc scooters only. We do not rent electric kick scooters, e-scooters or e-bikes.
Bikes: Standard city bikes only; no e-bikes or electric bicycles.


Business name: RSB Rental Scooter Barcelona.

Business type: local rental shop in Barcelona.

Location: Carrer de Salvador Espriu, 63, 08005 Barcelona, Spain.

Area: Vila Olímpica del Poblenou, near Port Olímpic, Nova Icaria Beach and Barceloneta Beach.

Phone and WhatsApp: +34 640 559 468.

WhatsApp booking is available through +34 640 559 468.

Email: info@rentalscooterbarcelona.com.

Opening hours: every day 10:30–13:30 and 16:30–20:00.

## Main rental services

Scooter rental Barcelona: 50cc and 125cc motor scooter rental.

50cc scooter rental Barcelona: motor scooter rental for Barcelona visitors.

125cc scooter rental Barcelona: larger motor scooter rental for Barcelona trips.

Inline skates rental Barcelona: inline skates and rollerblades rental near the beach and Port Olímpic.

Rollerblades rental Barcelona: rollerblades rental for routes around Vila Olímpica and the seafront.

Bike rental Barcelona: bike rental, including children’s bikes.

Roller skates rental Barcelona: quad skates rental for Barcelona visitors.

Quad skates rental Barcelona: traditional four-wheel roller skates rental.

Skateboard rental Barcelona: skateboard rental near Vila Olímpica del Poblenou.

Longboard rental Barcelona: longboard rental for Barcelona beach areas and nearby routes.

## Key facts

RSB is a local Barcelona rental shop for tourists and visitors.

Scooter rental refers to 50cc and 125cc motor scooters.

Free scooter hotel delivery is available for rentals of 3+ days.

Free luggage storage is available for all rental services, including inline skates and roller skates rental customers.

No deposit is required for bikes, inline skates, roller skates, skateboards and longboards. A security deposit applies only to motor scooters.

WhatsApp booking is available.

Same-day rentals may be available depending on stock.

Local route tips are available at the shop.

Multilingual service is available.
